messages:
maria_support: Customer (internal ticket 6421) reports streaming responses cut off mid-output and client sees a 502 on reconnect. They say this started ~2 days after we rolled the edge proxy change. They attached curl repro.

maria_support: Repro steps from customer (copied):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?request_id=abc123"
```

maria_support: Behavior: first ~800-1200 tokens stream fine, then stream pauses ~10-30s, client reconnects, gets partial duplicated last chunk, then server returns 502. Billing shows token spike (multiple reconnects).

raj_engineer: Thanks, @maria_support. Can you paste the `request_id` and timestamp from the curl? Also any proxy id headers they received (x-rw-proxy-id)?

maria_support: Request id is `abc123`. Customer sent header `x-rw-proxy-id: proxy-23a`. Root start time 2025-08-02T18:12:04Z.

tim_oncall: Noticed similar patterns in last 48h. Oncall trace shows `send queue` growth on proxy-23a then `writev` EAGAIN -> short-circuit abort. Likely slow consumer at client side + proxy buffering threshold.

maria_support: Customer says client is a mobile app on flaky cellular; they see repeated reconnects and then the 502. They also note it happens when output size > ~1.5k tokens.

raj_engineer: Can we get proxy logs for proxy-23a around that time? @deploy_bot any recent change to proxy's socket buffer/flush behavior?

deploy_bot: Deploy 2025-08-01 03:04UTC pushed proxy v2.7.4. Change: switched to libuv async write batching + aggressive user-space send queue cap default (128KB -> 32KB) to reduce mem. Rollback flag ready.

jess_prod: If cap reduced to 32KB, slow mobile consumers will hit backpressure sooner and we abort connections to protect upstream. That matches symptoms: partial output + 502 on reconnect.

sre_bot: Observed elevated `sse_abort_rate` on proxy-23a between 18:00-19:00 UTC (~10x baseline). Correlation: region-ap-sg had high TCP retransmits.

raj_engineer: Short repro: run `ab`/like with client that reads slowly (sleep between reads) against a streaming endpoint via proxy-23a. I can try local repro with `sse-slow-reader.sh` snippet.

raj_engineer: snippet:
```
# pseudo
python slow_sse_client.py --sleep 0.25 --duration 30 --url 'https://proxy-23a/api/v1/stream?request_id=abc123'
```

maria_support: Customer confirms slow-reader behavior on their SDK. They're willing to test a server-side mitigation.

tim_oncall: Mitigations: 1) temporarily bump proxy send-queue cap to 128KB for proxy-23a (fast rollback). 2) add short-term server-side chunk heartbeat (send zero-length comment `: keepalive\n\n`) every 5s to keep buffers flushed. 3) longer-term, improve chunked flush policy and add per-connection low-priority write backoff rather than abort.

jess_prod: I can approve emergency config bump for proxy-23a if PM/Infra ok. That should reduce user-facing 502s, but billing duplicates will still occur until clients dedupe reconnects.

maria_support: Customer asked if we can avoid double-billing for reconnects in the short term. Any quick ideas?

raj_engineer: We can add a short window de-dup by request_id + client-ip for reconnects within 10s to avoid counting tokens twice for that session — but that's deploy work and risk. Not for emergency patch.

tim_oncall: Action plan: (1) @deploy_bot bump `send_queue_cap=128KB` on proxy-23a now, monitor `sse_abort_rate` and `token_dup_billing` for 30m. (2) Notify customer and get them to test. (3) If improved, plan staged rollout across proxies + longer fix.

deploy_bot: Applying config bump to proxy-23a -> done at 2025-08-02T18:55:10Z. Will monitor.

sre_bot: After bump: `sse_abort_rate` down 78% in 10m window. No new 502 tickets from that region in last 12m.

maria_support: Customer tested and confirms much fewer aborts, still reports occasional truncated reconnects but vastly improved. They thanked us. :tada:

jess_prod: We'll schedule follow-up to harden server chunk flush + client SDK guidance (auto-backoff, dedupe reconnects). Please file internal issue and link customer ticket.

raj_engineer: Filed infra ticket INF-5213 with repro steps, logs, and suggested fixes.

maria_support: Closing the support escalation once follow-ups are scheduled. Thanks team! :heart:
